headlines.title: U.S. managed $12 billion in Venezuelan oil revenue, State Department says
headlines.summary: Amid demands for transparency, the State Department released a report detailing the oil funds received by the United States and disbursed back to Venezuela.

headlines.title: As deadly storms flood Gaza’s tent cities, the displaced fear a worse winter
headlines.summary: At least four people were killed when weekend storms triggered a landslide onto tent shelters, which are exposed to risks during severe weather.

headlines.title: After meeting Putin, U.S. envoys say Europe to join talks on ending Ukraine war
headlines.summary: Russia had resisted a European role in the negotiations, and President Vladimir Putin on Thursday reiterated his opposition to European peacekeepers.

headlines.title: Four grizzly bears killed Canadian mother and daughter, authorities say
headlines.summary: DNA testing showed that a mother bear and her three cubs attacked and killed Jennifer Balcarras and Selah Reed in British Columbia last week, authorities said.

headlines.title: Trump says no deal needed with Iran, closes down Vance negotiations
headlines.summary: The president suggested Thursday that he was dialing back diplomatic efforts to end the conflict with Iran and ending a dealmaking effort by the vice president.

headlines.title: Iran targets US radar in Bahrain; Trump says Gulf allies urged strike pause
headlines.summary: Trump says Gulf countries asked him to hold off on further attacks against Iran as Tehran targets US radar in Bahrain.

headlines.title: Iran says it targeted US radar site in Bahrain
headlines.summary: IRGC says it hit radar in retaliation for an 'enemy' air attack on a telecom tower in Iran's Hormozgan province.

headlines.title: Trump moots toppling Cuba authorities before leaving office
headlines.summary: Calling Cuba a failed nation, the US president hints at attack on the country before his term ends.

headlines.title: Finland detects strike on Russian warship as Zelenskyy meets US envoys
headlines.summary: Reports of attack in Baltic came before US envoys met with Russian and Ukrainian presidents.

headlines.title: Spanish court suspends far-right group over alleged hate crimes
headlines.summary: Judge orders office shut and accounts blocked after 14 arrests and the seizure of more than 20 firearms.

headlines.title: Chris Van Hollen says he will challenge Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader
headlines.summary: Van Hollen, a progressive from Maryland, said voters sent a clear message in the midterm elections — that they want "change from the status quo."

headlines.title: Is Outlook down? Widespread outage hits Microsoft email and other apps
headlines.summary: A widespread outage has hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook, with many users encountering trouble using their email accounts.

headlines.title: Cindy Holscher wins in Kansas, holding governor's office for Democrats
headlines.summary: Holscher, a state senator, overcame a more well-known Republican who had Trump's endorsement in the state that has gone to the GOP in most other statewide races.

headlines.title: What's a Honey Trap? The spy tactic that helped topple Jensen Huang
headlines.summary: Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, the leading AI chipmaker, resigned after admitting an extramarital affair with a woman the U.S. says is a Chinese spy. This espionage tactic is known as a honey trap.

headlines.title: US midterm election results trigger debate
headlines.summary: A majority of Americans support efforts to repeal tariffs of the US administration, a Reuters/Ipsos poll shows, as experts debate how far the incoming Democratic-controlled Congress can reshape trade policy and the US approach to China.

headlines.title: Europe weighs up US midterm power shift
headlines.summary: Many Europeans were relieved when the Republican Party lost control of both chambers of the United States Congress in the Nov 3 midterm elections, with the Democratic Party securing majorities in both the House of Representatives and the Senate.

headlines.title: Suspect dies after shooting north of White House
headlines.summary: WASHINGTON -- A shooting at a gym about 1.6 km north of the White House early Thursday left one person dead and four others injured. The suspected gunman later died, US media reported.

headlines.title: School bomb threats treated as hoaxes
headlines.summary: Bomb threats sent to thousands of schools across the United Kingdom, Ireland and Italy are being treated as hoaxes by police — the latest in a wave of hoaxes and disruptions that have hit Europe in recent weeks.

headlines.title: Guinea aims to turn iron ore wealth into industrial growth
headlines.summary: Guinea is seeking backing to convert its vast Simandou iron ore deposits into a driver of industrial growth, leveraging significant Chinese investment and international partnerships to expand infrastructure, develop local industries and create jobs beyond mineral exports.

headlines.title: India’s ambassador to Oman visits injured Indian seafarer in hospital
headlines.summary: Indian Ambassador to Oman visits injured seafarer from MSV Quba attack; embassy reaffirms support and commitment to assistance.

headlines.title: Kolkata-Sairang train derailment: Preliminary probe points to faulty braking system
headlines.summary: Preliminary probe cites isolated BP angle cock in locomotive as braking failure culprit in Kolkata-Sairang derailment; investigators seek who disabled it.

headlines.title: OBC associations call for protest at Ramlila Maidan demanding drop-down for all castes in 2027 Census
headlines.summary: OBC groups demand a drop-down caste menu with unique codes for all castes in the 2027 Census amid nationwide protests.

headlines.title: Microsoft outage impacts IndiGo and Air India’s email support services
headlines.summary: IndiGo and Air India report email outage due to Microsoft disruption, while other support channels remain active and recovery is underway.

headlines.title: Opposition not informed about possible Special Parliament session on delimitation: Priyanka Gandhi
headlines.summary: Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi says opposition not informed about any potential special Parliament session on delimitation, warns dissent being silenced.
